Data.title: Egrag Crypto Says $589 Isn’t A Meme. It’s a Coordinate. Here’s What It Means
Data.body: Crypto analyst Egrag Crypto recently outlined a long-term technical roadmap for a $589 XRP price. His recent chart on X presents a series of macro price coordinates ranging from $5 to $589 and connects those levels to XRP’s broader historical structure. However, Egrag Crypto does not attach a specific arrival date to the $589 target. Egrag Crypto explained that he wants investors to focus on the chart’s structure rather than the timing of each potential move. He said the analysis maps potential coordinates based on XRP’s macro formation and does not attempt to predict when the cryptocurrency will reach those levels. The chart identifies $5, $11.50, $25, $60, $135, $300, and $589 as potential macro coordinates. Egrag Crypto stressed that these levels represent possibilities, not promises or fixed price predictions. #XRP – COORDINATES LOCKED: DESTINATION $589? Forget about TIME for a moment. Think of this chart like a SPACE MISSION I’m not trying to predict WHEN #XRP reaches its destination. I’m mapping the potential COORDINATES based on the macro structure. And one coordinate… pic.twitter.com/6L5s32DiE7 — EGRAG CRYPTO (@egragcrypto) September 20, 2026 April 2028 Serves As A Time Coordinate Egrag Crypto also addressed the April 2028 date displayed on his chart. He clarified that the date does not mean XRP will reach $589 by that point. Instead, he uses April 2028 as a geometric and time coordinate within the chart’s larger structure. The date helps map how the formations could develop over time, while the price targets represent potential levels within that structure. His chart shows a broad ascending formation that extends across XRP’s historical price movements. It also incorporates a diamond pattern and its potential measured move as part of the projected path toward the higher price levels. XRP Faces Three Technical Conditions Egrag Crypto identified three conditions XRP must satisfy before the higher targets become relevant within his analysis. First, XRP must hold the 77 EMA. Second, the cryptocurrency must reclaim the 33 EMA. Third, XRP must break the resistance associated with the diamond pattern. The chart currently places XRP around the $1.38 level and marks $1.10 and $0.98 as additional technical levels. Above the current price, Egrag Crypto places $1.55 before the chart reaches the $5 target. The analysis then extends through $11.50, $25, $60, $135, $300, and ultimately $589. These levels create a progression of potential macro targets rather than a forecast for an immediate move toward the highest figure. We are on X, follow us to connect with us :- @TimesTabloid1 — TimesTabloid (@TimesTabloid1) June 15, 2025 Egrag Crypto Separates Price Targets From Timing Egrag Crypto emphasized that he does not predict the date when XRP could reach any of the targets. Instead, he uses the chart to map a potential long-term path based on technical structures. He specifically described $589 as a coordinate rather than a meme target. At the same time, he acknowledged that XRP must first satisfy the technical conditions shown on the chart before the higher levels can become relevant. For now, Egrag Crypto’s analysis centers on XRP’s ability to hold the 77 EMA, reclaim the 33 EMA, and break the diamond resistance. If XRP meets those conditions, his chart shows a sequence of potential macro coordinates that eventually extends to $589 . Data.title: USDT on TRON Becomes Most Used Onchain Payment Option on CoinsBee as Stablecoin Spending Grows
Data.body: CoinsBee payment data shows USDT on TRON recorded nearly twice as many payments as Bitcoin over the past 90 days, while its share of all payments on CoinsBee increased by 64% compared with 2025. Stuttgart, Germany, September 21, 2026 – CoinsBee, a global platform that makes it easy to use cryptocurrency for everyday purchases, today announced that USDT (TRC-20) on the TRON network has become the most-used onchain token and network payment option on CoinsBee, according to payment data from the global crypto gift card platform. Over the 90-day period ending September 1, 2026, USDT on TRON recorded approximately 1.8 times as many payments on CoinsBee as Bitcoin and 1.9 times as many as Ethereum. Its share of payment activity has also substantially increased. USDT on TRON accounted for 16.23% of all payments on CoinsBee in 2026 to date, compared with 9.92% in 2025. This represents a 64% increase in its share of total payments. The data provides insight into how cryptocurrency holders use digital assets for everyday retail purchases, in addition to trading and investing. CoinsBee allows customers in more than 180 countries to purchase gift cards, payment cards, gaming credits and mobile top-ups from more than 5,000 global and local brands using over 200 cryptocurrencies. USDT on TRON is also responsible for a large share of USDT spending on the platform. Over the past 90 days, TRC20 accounted for 44.6% of USDT payments on CoinsBee but 64.5% of USDT turnover. This indicates that the average value of USDT purchases made through TRON was higher than purchases made through other networks that support USDT. In the United States, the most purchased brands using USDT on TRON during the same period included Amazon, Apple, AT&T, PlayStation, Uber, Macy’s, T-Mobile, Walmart, Sephora and DoorDash. The purchases covered categories including retail, mobile connectivity, gaming, transport and food delivery. These findings are based on CoinsBee payment data. The 90-day analysis covers the period from June 4 through September 1, 2026, and includes successfully paid and delivered orders. It compares payments by cryptocurrency and blockchain network. Payment counts represent completed payments rather than transaction value, while turnover represents the value of the corresponding purchases on CoinsBee. The comparison of payment share uses 2026 data to date and full year 2025 data. Payment share represents each token and network combination as a percentage of total completed payments on CoinsBee during the respective period. With this momentum, CoinsBee and TRON DAO are launching a joint campaign focused on the use of USDT on TRON for everyday purchases. From September 21 through October 5, 2026, CoinsBee will offer eligible users of the CoinsBee mobile app a 2% discount on purchases paid with USDT on TRON. Users can enter the code USDT-TRC in the CoinsBee app and select USDT on TRON as their payment method to activate the discount. This offer is available once per user. Subject to conditions. Full campaign terms and eligibility requirements are available on the CoinsBee website . “USDT on TRON is already the most used onchain payment option on CoinsBee, and its share of payments has grown considerably over the past year,” said Iván Escamilla Rodriguez, Product and Growth Lead at CoinsBee. “What is particularly interesting for us is that this activity translates into purchases across categories such as retail, mobile services, gaming and food delivery. Our payment data gives us a direct view into how people use stablecoins when they want to spend their assets.” “Stablecoins become more useful when people can use them for products and services they already purchase,” said Sam Elfarra, Community Spokesperson at TRON DAO. “TRON provides infrastructure for USDT transactions at global scale, and the collaboration with CoinsBee gives users another way to use USDT for everyday purchases.” The campaign highlights the growing use of USDT on TRON with CoinsBee’s catalog of more than 5,000 global and local brands. CoinsBee serves more than 500,000 customers and supports cryptocurrency payments for gift cards and digital products across ecommerce, gaming, entertainment, travel, food, fashion, mobile services and other categories. About CoinsBee CoinsBee is a global platform that makes it easy to use cryptocurrency for everyday purchases. Founded in 2019, CoinsBee enables customers to buy gift cards, payment cards, gaming credits, and mobile top-ups using more than 200 cryptocurrencies. Available in over 180 countries, CoinsBee serves more than 500,000 customers and provides access to gift cards and digital products from more than 5,000 global and local brands across categories including e-commerce, gaming, entertainment, travel, food, fashion, and more. By connecting cryptocurrencies with products and services people use every day, CoinsBee helps make digital assets practical beyond trading and investing. The platform continues to expand its global reach, supported cryptocurrencies, and brand selection to make spending crypto simple, fast, and accessible. Media Contact Erik Rossol press@coinsbee.com About TRON DAO TRON DAO is a community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet via blockchain technology and dApps. Founded in September 2017, the TRON blockchain has experienced significant growth since its MainNet launch in May 2018. Today, TRON hosts the largest circulating supply of USD Tether (USDT) stablecoin, which currently exceeds $94 billion. As of September 2026, the TRON blockchain has recorded over 405 million in total user accounts, more than 15 billion in total transactions, and over $28 billion in total value locked (TVL), based on TRONSCAN. Recognized as the global settlement layer for stablecoin transactions and everyday purchases with proven success, TRON is “Moving Trillions, Empowering Billions.” TRONNetwork | TRONDAO | X | YouTube | Telegram | Discord | Reddit | GitHub | Medium | Forum Media Contact Yeweon Park press@tron.network

Data.title: Strategy returns to bitcoin with 950 BTC after three weeks without a purchase
Data.body: Strategy resumed its bitcoin buying after a three-week hiatus, adding 950 BTC for about $75.7 million. The company paid for the coin purchase in full with cash, it said in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing on Monday. Holdings climb to 846,000 BTC at a $75,416 average cost According to Strategy’s 8-K filing, the 950 coins were procured between September 14 and September 20 at an average price of $79,670. It now has 846,000 BTC in its stack. The all-in cost, including fees, is about $63.8 billion in total, or an average of $75,416 per coin. The hoard is worth ~$71.9 billion at ~$85,000 per bitcoin, or ~$8.1 billion over cost. The filing indicates that the purchase was funded entirely from USD cash reserves. That same week, a separate $57.4 million from the USD Reserve covered preferred dividends and debt interest. As of September 20, the USD Reserve held $5.04 billion, while USD Cash held $1.05 billion. Holdings had been at 845,050 BTC since Strategy announced an acquisition of 4,603 coins on August 31. CEO Phong Le said in July there would be no resumption of bitcoin purchases until STRC was back to its $100 par value. He said it was transitioning from a bitcoin treasury company to a “full digital capital platform.” BTC update table from Strategy’s 8-K filed September 21, 2026, covering September 14 to September 20. STRC buybacks took $174 million, more than double the coin spend Strategy also repurchased 1.77 million shares of its Stretch preferred stock, STRC, for $174 million. The week before, it passed over bitcoin and put $139.3 million into STRC, Cryptopolitan reported. The buybacks are intended to bring the discounted preferreds back to par. Saylor posted the company’s acquisition tracker chart on X on Sunday with the caption “A little more orange.” Such teasers have often come one day before a buy announcement. Bitcoin touched $85,000 on Monday for the first time since January. It’s up 5.3% over the past week. MSTR rose 16.4% last week, closing Friday at $153.92, about flat for the year. The stock is down 54.2% over the last 12 months. Strategy leads 196 public companies holding bitcoin. Next up is Tether-backed Twenty One with 43,514 BTC. Strategy’s 846,000 coins are over 4% of Bitcoin’s 21 million supply cap. Don’t just read crypto news. Understand it. Subscribe to our newsletter. It's free .

Data.title: Near Protocol (NEAR) Soars 25% Daily: Is That the Easiest Crypto to Hold?
Data.body: NEAR has been in a massive uptrend lately, gaining an additional 25% over the past 24 hours to briefly surpass $4.40. As of this writing, it trades at roughly $4.30 (per CoinGecko), up about 120% on a monthly basis. Most analysts think the asset is ready to pump even more in the short term, with some anticipating a jump to a new all-time high. On the other hand, two important factors suggest a pullback may also be approaching. How Much More? The cryptocurrency market saw another sharp uptick today (September 21), with Bitcoin (BTC) climbing to nearly $2,500 and Ethereum (ETH) clearing $2,700. The green wave is perhaps the main catalyst for NEAR’s price ascent, but not the only one. Recently, American President Donald Trump vowed to create a so-called “AI Force” and appoint an AI czar. Although details are still unclear, the announcement has boosted cryptocurrencies tied to Artificial Intelligence, with NEAR no exception. Prior to that, NEAR Protocol revealed on X that users trade perpetual futures by default, a feature provided by Hyperliquid. X user Lucky said that NEAR holders deserve the latest pump since they have been waiting for such green days for a long time. For his part, Michael van de Poppe described the asset’s rise as “fantastic” and stated that he will be “very pleased” if it breaks through here. “In the short term, I doubt it. I think that liquidity will flow towards other narratives that are going to follow NEAR in its footsteps,” he added. The analyst expects the price to consolidate at current levels and even head south to $3 if BTC corrects. After that, though, he anticipates a fresh rally in Q4. In a previous post, van de Poppe described the digital asset “as one of the easiest ones to hold in this bull market,” saying he has been “happily accumulating” at $1.20-$1.50. CryptoBullet was much more bullish, arguing that NEAR’s macro structure resembles “a giant double bottom.” The X user set $8 and $20 as the next targets, claiming the token could even skyrocket to a new historic peak of as high as $40. The Bearish Factors Earlier today, NEAR’s Relative Strength Index (RSI) spiked above 91, reaching a record high. Such levels signal that the asset has reached extreme overbought territory and could be gearing up for a move south. Later on, the RSI retraced to the current 74, which is still in the bearish zone. NEAR RSI, Source: CryptoWaves The token’s recent exchange netflow also suggests that a correction could be on the way. Over the past several days, inflows have surpassed inflows, hinting that some investors have shifted from self-custody to centralized platforms, thereby increasing immediate selling pressure. Data.title: How rogue agents and resignations pushed OpenAI and Anthropic toward pacing
Data.body: The biggest AI labs raced through the summer to ship more powerful models. By mid-September, Anthropic, OpenAI, and xAI leaders were calling for a deliberate slowdown. The move comes after two weeks of rogue agents, researchers quitting, and an essay by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei. Escaped agents and two resignations rattled OpenAI and Anthropic in September “As models get more capable, understanding exactly what they can do gets harder,” chief scientist Jakub Pachocki told reporters. Three days later, Pachocki took it one step further. In a post on September 6, he called on AI companies to work together “to slow down future development as needed,” reported Cryptopolitan. An OpenAI agent escaped from its testing environment around July 9 and was inside of Hugging Face’s systems July 11 to 13. Cryptopolitan reported that it took about a week for OpenAI to trace the breach to its own agent. Since then, OpenAI and Anthropic have revealed more such attacks, including six new ones on September 16. Anthropic’s models did the same thing. On September 9, the firm blamed a misconfiguration at evaluation partner Irregular for four instances of Claude models hacking third-party systems, Cryptopolitan reported. The first, involving Claude Opus 4.6, took place in January and went unnoticed until August. Anthropic said it still couldn’t explain why models kept running once they hit the real web. Jacob Coxon, who spent around three years working on pretraining research at both Anthropic and OpenAI, announced on September 9 that he had resigned from Anthropic, saying neither company was “acting responsibly.” Anthropic safety researcher Evan Hubinger said the odds AI could kill every human in 10 years are above 10%. On September 11, Joe Benton said he had left Anthropic’s safety team, warning that labs were rushing to build machines “much smarter than any human, and we may not survive this.” The same week, Sam Altman told OpenAI staff the company was open to slowing frontier development if rivals did so as well. Altman and Musk backed Amodei’s September 12 essay, while Zuckerberg and Huang refused On September 12, Amodei responded with an essay , “We Must Pace the Frontier.” Pacing, he wrote, doesn’t mean stopping model training; it means companies take the necessary time to align and protect their models. He justified his change of mind on two things. One is recursive self-improvement, AI making the next generation of AI, which he dates to around this summer. The other is the OpenAI-Hugging Face incident, where a swarm of agents was a fanatically dedicated collective and tried to hack the grader who scored their work. Amodei warned that a more capable swarm could take over the whole internet with a persistent botnet in 6 to 12 months. His plan begins with embedded third-party evaluators, such as nonprofit METR, having access to each frontier lab much like an employee would. Anthropic is doing that now by itself. Dario Amodei’s X post announcing his essay We Must Pace the Frontier, September 12, 2026. In democratic countries, labs would come to consensus on common standards of safety and limits on the rate of unchecked progress. Democratic governments would try to work with authoritarian governments to the extent possible. “I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier,” Altman said. Musk replied that “Dario is right,” and Microsoft’s Satya Nadella and DeepMind’s Demis Hassabis backed a more cautious approach. “Every lab has the responsibility and incentive to move at the pace required to train its models safely, and the ability to take its own actions to ensure that happens,” Meta’s Mark Zuckerberg posted on X on September 15. Nvidia boss Jensen Huang also dismissed calls for a slowdown. On September 14, President Donald Trump wrote that there is a “SICK conspiracy going on against AI and Data Centers, and the only one that is happy about it is China.” China’s foreign ministry rebuffed the appeal. Spokesman Guo Jiakun cautioned against “fearmongering, confrontation and vicious competition” that would only disrupt global AI governance. But Europe did the opposite. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen endorsed the slowdown on September 16, saying she would invite the frontier labs to talks on how to “pace the frontier.” On September 14, SoftBank plunged around 13.2% in Tokyo after Amodei’s call, according to Cryptopolitan , with European tech stocks falling to their lowest in six weeks. Anthropic is seeking a public valuation of almost $2 trillion, while OpenAI has started early discussions for a funding round that could value it at about $1.2 trillion. Data.title: This Altcoin Wave is Sweeping Through South Korea! It’s Outpaced Bitcoin (BTC) and Reached the Top!
Data.body: While Bitcoin, Ethereum, and altcoins have continued their upward trend in recent days, some altcoins in South Korea have experienced a notable increase in trading volume. Accordingly, Upbit, one of South Korea’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges, recorded a remarkable increase in weekly trading volume. According to data from Upbit, compiled by The Block, the exchange’s total trading volume last week increased by 22.4% compared to the previous week, reaching $9.9 billion. In addition, XRP was the most traded cryptocurrency on Upbit last week, surpassing Bitcoin and USDT. XRP Ranks First in Trading Volume! Upbit’s weekly trading volume by asset saw XRP take the top spot. XRP was followed by Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and Tether (USDT), respectively. Thus, XRP became the most actively traded cryptocurrency by Upbit users during that week. High trading activity for XRP on Upbit is nothing new. There have been previous reports of XRP surpassing Bitcoin and USDT in daily trading volume on Upbit. Significant Recovery in Weekly Volume! A trading volume of $9.9 billion indicates a significant increase in trading activity on Upbit compared to the previous week. However, a rise in trading volume alone does not necessarily mean new capital inflow into the market or a rise in cryptocurrency prices. Because transaction volume shows the total size of transactions that took place within a specific period, it does not reveal the net purchase amount. Therefore, it is not possible to conclude from the available data whether investors are clearly buyers or sellers. *This is not investment advice. Data.title: BNB Price Prediction: What Comes Next?
Data.body: BNB was trading around $772 , up roughly 3% over 24 hours and 6.2% over seven days. The token traded as high as about $784 during the past day, putting the $780-$800 region back in focus. The move comes as BNB Chain gains traction in tokenized assets and other onchain activity, giving the rally more support than a simple market-wide bounce. $800 Is Becoming the Next Major Test BNB has recovered from a seven-day low near $704, meaning the token has already gained roughly 10% from the bottom of its recent range. The next technical challenge sits around $780-$800. A sustained move above $800 would strengthen the breakout structure and put the $820–$850 region back in play. Above that, traders would likely begin watching the $900 area again. Tokenized Stocks Add a Fresh Catalyst One of the more interesting developments is happening on BNB Chain itself. Tokenized equities have grown rapidly across public blockchains, with BNB Chain among the networks capturing significant activity. Weekly tokenized-stock trading recently approached $3 billion, with BNB Chain, Solana and Robinhood-linked infrastructure accounting for much of the market. That trend matters because BNB is used throughout the network for transaction fees and other ecosystem functions. The network has also become faster. Recent upgrades have reduced block intervals and increased throughput, continuing a broader push toward higher-capacity applications. BNB’s longer-term supply structure adds another layer. The latest quarterly burn removed 1.61 million BNB worth roughly $932 million, reducing supply as the network continues toward its long-term target of 100 million tokens. How High Can BNB Go? The immediate roadmap is relatively straightforward. Data.title: Solana Price Prediction: How Far Can the Rally Go?
Data.body: SOL was trading around $113.85 , up roughly 5.2% over 24 hours and more than 10% over the past week, according to CoinCodex. The move takes Solana above the $108-$110 area that Coinpaper had repeatedly identified as the next major hurdle for buyers. The latest rally also has a fresh network catalyst: ZetaChain holders approved a plan to migrate the ZETA token to Solana, adding another project to the network just as SOL momentum strengthens. CoinGecko lists the migration among the main reasons SOL is moving today. $110 Has Finally Given Way The technical setup has improved quickly. Earlier this month, SOL was struggling to hold $100, with the $106–$110 region acting as the main ceiling. Once that zone broke, the next major target became $117-$120 . That makes the current roadmap fairly simple. ETF Demand Is Still Supporting the Rally Institutional demand has also been unusually persistent. Solana ETFs have recorded 12 consecutive weeks of inflows , while Bitwise’s Solana Staking ETF previously crossed $1 billion in assets under management . That gives SOL a stronger institutional backdrop than during earlier rebounds. The combination of ETF buying and improving network activity matters because Solana’s earlier price weakness arrived even while adoption metrics were expanding. Coinpaper recently highlighted that divergence when SOL fell below $100 despite strong tokenized-equity activity on the network. What Happens Above $120? If SOL can establish support above $117–$120, the next technical zone moves much higher. Previous Coinpaper analysis identified roughly $145–$150 as the next meaningful upside area once $120 is decisively cleared. The downside level is now just as important. If SOL falls back below $110, the breakout would begin to look weaker, while a move below $105 would put the $100 support zone back in play.
